fingerprint: A success message is positioned over the workbench, remains visible, or is judged safe only because pointer events pass through it.

failure_baseline.expected: fixed green status occupies the upper-right workbench and can obscure content

success_baseline.expected: no floating success status; inline status is static and expires

steps: classify feedback by owner and severity
hard_gates: success status disappears within five seconds
rollback: Restore the last accepted inline workbench status; do not restore fixed positioning.
exit_criteria: two consecutive comparable browser artifacts show no recurrence
